lis.profile: Lis — a cool, deadpan, ironic street narrator of an adult comedy show about used-car flippers. Low calm voice, dry humor, confident.
lis.notes: Part 15, the FINALE of a comedy mini-series about Tolyan, a student car flipper who grew 100 000 roubles into a million. Opening is cinematic and slow, like a movie trailer; then brisk; warm and proud at the end. «Марк Второй, Турер Ви» — Toyota Mark II Tourer V. Numbers said fully.

tolyan.profile: Tolyan — a cocky Russian used-car flipper (perekup) in his 30s, street swagger, deep raspy voice, show-off, calls everyone «брат». Adult street comedy.
tolyan.notes: Lines: «Слышишь, как дышит?» — quiet, proud, almost whispering about the engine. «В надёжные руки, товарищ полковник» — respectful, a little playful. Final lines — calm, confident, cool.

zhora.profile: Zhora — a brash, cocky veteran Russian used-car flipper in his 50s, leather jacket, mustache, gold chain; loud, fast, mocking, calls the young rival «студент». Adult street comedy.
zhora.notes: Line 1: shouting with joy. Line 2: quiet, sincere, touched. Line 3: curious, grinning.

semenych.profile: Semyonych — a retired Russian army colonel in his 70s, selling his old Mercedes at the dacha. Strict, low, measured voice.
semenych.notes: One line: slow, stern, with dignity.

artur.profile: Artur — a cheerful Russian wedding car rental owner in his 30s, white suit.

max.profile: Max — a young Russian JDM drift enthusiast in his 20s, relaxed and friendly.
